notes.title: Foddia v1.3.2 Hotfix Patch Notes!
notes.notes:
Implemented a feature where cell phone will pop up to tell player what song is playing
Fixed a bug where camera was flickering at beginning of new game
Fixed a bug where controller and keyboard input UIs were overlapping
Fixed a bug where player would bonk against wall surfaces early and enter free-fall

notes.title: Foddia v1.3.1 Hotfix Patch Notes!
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug where the graphics menu and the audio menu would not load user preferences properly
Fixed a bug where the dizzy bonk SFX would not scale properly with the SFX volume level

notes.title: Foddia v1.3.0 Release Patch Notes!
notes.notes:
Changed backend coding for loading assets in the game to reduce lag 
Added in controller support in all places it was missing (button display screen, ending screens, and MP3 selection in the pause menu)
Added UI for up and down climbing presses to swinging ropes when climbing them
Added a new achievement
Added certain stats to the game's end screens
Moved certain tiles in the middle of Beta Bluffs
Fixed a bug where landing from bonking animation would last too long
Fixed a bug in Foddian mode where falling a great distance would not result in hard landing
Fixed a bug where the moveable camera was causing the player to appear to jitter

notes.title: Foddia v1.2.0 Release Patch Notes!
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug where the player could still move while in the Teleporter Menu
Fixed a bug where certain swinging ropes would not allow the player to rotate with them
Changed the game feel for bonking (should happen less often now and feel more justified when it does happen)
Fixed a bug where certain collectibles would not be hidden by reveal walls
Investigated a bug where the player would slide off of the corner of a floor or wall. Could not fix bug (it is a Godot2D bug https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/91494)

notes.title: Foddia v1.1.4 Hotfix Patch Notes!
notes.notes: Enhancing game-feel for swinging ropes to feel more like the demo version of the game

notes.title: Foddia v1.1.3 Hotfix Patch Notes!
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug where player would bonk against wall surfaces early and enter free-fall
Fixed a bug where the bottom rung of swing ropes would sometimes get stuck on the rung above it

notes.title: Foddia v1.1.1 Hotfix Patch Notes!
notes.notes: Attempted to return the game feel for swinging ropes back to how it felt in the Demo

notes.title: Foddia v1.1.0 Release Patch Notes!
notes.notes:
Attempted to return the game feel for swinging ropes back to how it felt in the Demo
 Added controller/ keyboard visuals to the Post-it Board tutorials
 MP3-Collectible Songs now scale with the BGM volume bar, as they should
 Fixed incorrect dialogue triggers for Ending Cutscenes/ Post-Game
 Add "Reset" button to Permadeath Mode
 Fixed a bug where the teleporter map was accessible while not in the Jort
 Attempted to fix a bug where the bottom rung of the swinging ropes flip the player upside-down sometimes
 Made controller display more clear for when to press the "Select" button
 Changed some textures at "The Problem" and "Pandemonium I"
 Added visible cues of player while they are in free-fall
 Added visible cues of player kicking while on swinging ropes
 Added visible and audible cues of player when they are sliding on ice
 Added an FPS-display button (press the "F" key on a keyboard or press "R3" on a controller)
 Fixed a bug where you could live forever in Relaxed or Permadeath Mode after being in the Elevator
 Fixed UI for Jetpack fuel
 Fixed a bug where Area Titles would not appear sometimes
 Fixed a bug where the camera would not center back on the player after death
